Benefit.title: Species benefits
Benefit.conditionsHint: Known mechanical conditions apply automatically. Check a benefit only when its full source condition applies to this task. Assets share the normal cap.
Benefit.damageTags: Declared damage nature (exclude automatic species protection from other protection totals)
Benefit.spears: A spear or its high-tech version
Benefit.pheromones: Positive social interaction with an affected target
Benefit.shapedBody: The specific task for the prepared body shape
Benefit.undergroundMountains: Navigation underground or in mountainous areas
Benefit.notDragon: Intimidation against a target other than a dragon or dragonfolk
Benefit.prepareHint: Declare the particular task or environment. Preparation takes ten minutes of game time; confirm completion only if it was uninterrupted.
Benefit.finishHint: Have the ten game minutes passed with uninterrupted preparation for the declared task or environment?
Benefit.refreshHint: Link old generated benefits only when their recorded source and slot can be resolved. Existing skill training is preserved and requires a separate explicit review.
Benefit.reviewHint: Select the skill granted by this species and explicitly confirm its independent training level. Do not remove training acquired from another source.
Benefit.unavailable: Benefit unavailable: check source, ownership, preparation and declared condition.
Benefit.intellectRecovery: One extra Intellect point per recovery
Benefit.refreshed: Source-bound benefits linked: {count}. Review conditional skill training separately.
